mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering useful substances showed why the kidney cannot simply remove wastes in one step.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the ureters and bladder was clear but fairly predictable because the slots named both parts.

surprise.text: Useful glucose, salts and water passed through the filter along with wastes, then useful substances and much water returned to blood.

arbitrary.text: Using the whole body to collect the fluid seemed reasonable after the urinary organs were connected, but the game required the separate kidney pair instead.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the filter-and-recovery sequence made a familiar organ's job more understandable, and I would be curious to see another body process built this way.
